messages:
tariq (partnerships): Heads-up: new CloudPartnerX refkit prototype pushed to private registry. Contains: terraform module, helm quickstart, marketplace metadata + license checklist. Need quick eng sign-off for publish.

emily (solutions): Nice. can you drop the tf example here? i'll smoke on both x86 and arm.

tariq (partnerships): example snippet:
```hcl
module "cpx_refkit" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refkit//modules/cpx"
  region = "eu-west-1"
  node_size = "c6g.4xlarge"
  accelerator = "ampere-a10x"
  marketplace_enable = true
}
```
Repo: github.com/redwood/refkit (internal) branch: cpx/marketplace-proto

rob (platform): CI plan: GH Actions matrix -> tf 1.4 / 1.5; aws provider 4.x + 5.x; arch: amd64, arm64; runtime smoke with containerized GPU emulator. I'll add `ci/compatibility.yml`.

emily (solutions): small API nit: variable `accelerator` is ambiguous. prefer `accelerator_profile` to match other modules. also please support `spot=true` toggle in example.

tariq (partnerships): ok will update variables. also need a marketplace metadata file for legal: `marketplace.yaml` includes telemetry opt-in checkbox and license text. Any legal or compliance flags?

nina (docs): docs ask: include quickstart note for customers using managed nodegroups -> label + tolerations sample. i'll author a short KB and user-facing quickstart.

infra-bot: Registry entry created: refkit/cloudpartnerx v0.2.0-rc -> staged. CI triggered: ci/compatibility.yml.

emily (solutions): ran arm smoke: terraform apply failed due to helm chart nodeSelector expecting `gpu=true`. logs: `0/3 nodes are available: 3 node(s) didn't match node selector`. Quick fix: chart values need nodeSelector conditional and null default.

rob (platform): noted. i'll add an integration test for chart with default nodeSelector: {} and an explicit example in values.yaml. Also adding an OPA pre-merge policy to check `marketplace.yaml` contains required keys: license, telemetry, support_contact.

tariq (partnerships): timeline: want to push from rc->stable by next Tuesday for partner announcement. blockers?

emily (solutions): blocker: update var name in module and examples, re-run tests. estimate 4 hours.

nina (docs): blocker: need final wording on telemetry opt-in copy from legal. pinging legal separately. ETA tomorrow AM.

rob (platform): infra blocker: need one more Ampere runner in our CI pool. opened INF-2330, ETA Mon noon.

tariq (partnerships): thanks. i'll update branch with variable rename and the marketplace metadata template. will post PR and tag owners when ready. :white_check_mark:
